name: RoboVerse

summaryEn: A scalable embodied resource unifying robot-learning simulation, task data, and evaluation protocols.
scale: Unified platform integrating multiple manipulation tasks and asset collections
scaleZh: 统一整合多个操作任务和素材集合的平台

accessZh: 平台、任务和基准代码已公开

verdictEn: An open platform for scalable robot interaction trajectories and unified evaluation
wmNote: 统一仿真和任务接口适合产生动作条件世界模型训练数据。

evidence.sourceTitle: [2504.18904] RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
evidence.statement: MetaSim exposes simulator initialization, physical stepping and shared interfaces; generated data is evaluated for world-model learning and policy learning.
